name: Roll-Up
description: Roll up from lying down one vertebra at a time, reach forward over your legs, then roll back down with control.

source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms reaching overhead on the mat.
cues: Lift your arms first, then your head, then peel your spine off the mat.
Reach past your toes with a rounded back.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Arms up, chin in
keyframes.cue: Bring your arms to the ceiling and curl your head up.

keyframes.name: Roll up and reach
keyframes.cue: Peel up and reach forward over your legs.

keyframes.name: Roll back down
keyframes.cue: Curl back down, one vertebra at a time.
